criteria.photon_materials: Lighter shared iron now reads on sunlit and shaded faces under Photon/Faithful. Original casing and copper slab contrast intentionally as foundation/support materials. No whole-block emissive casing.
criteria.scale_readability: Large open octagonal wheel and horizontal rear cylinder read clearly; case/front dial and copper utility support distinguish the working sides. Bed clearance and aligned shaft visible in opposite views.
criteria.states_motion: Stopped/starting wheel at rest; running and motion frames show rim and spokes rotating as one unit. Rear startup flame appears below hot bulb and vanishes after warmup; working exhaust uses stack location.
criteria.interaction_guides: Missing wheel has matching transparent full geometry, clear original component requirement and corrected Oil Engine heading; completed build has no guide text. Ports remain accessible.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Controller, cylinder and wheel now fit individual slots, distinct silhouettes and matching materials. Held controller renders with same front/side geometry.
criteria.integration_limits: This review covers the land multiblock in the hidden 1920x1080 Photon/Faithful scene. Server checks cover four-direction linking/removal. No new boat integration or moving-vessel animation claim; no capacity/load claim.
